Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by listed pharmacies per 10,000 residents ascending, left-joining pharmacy counts and CDC total population so zero-count tracts are included with a rate of 0 and tracts with missing population sort last.
sql:
WITH pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(CAST(n AS DOUBLE)) AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_215483' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
pop AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, MAX(CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE)) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_215483_m2_cdc
  GROUP BY tractfips
)
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  CASE WHEN p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0 THEN (COALESCE(c.pharmacy_count, 0) / p.totalpopulation) * 10000 END AS pharmacies_per_10000_residents,
  COALESCE(c.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
  p.totalpopulation AS totalpopulation,
  t.geoid AS geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN pharmacy_counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
LEFT JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pharmacies_per_10000_residents ASC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
